text_block_list.text: ――Yay, we did it! Another personal best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I've been in super top form lately~! 
Right now, it feels like... I can do 
anything..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?
What's with you all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Um, you know... The reason I 
was able to get this fast—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"It's all because you're always giving 
your absolute all to coach me, 
Trainer...!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"When that hit me, I was just so, so 
happy...! Thank you so, so, so very 
much!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer gave me everything they've got, so 
I'm gonna give it everything I've got in 
returnーーー!!

...Seeing Winning Ticket's tears of joy 
made me resolve to keep doing my best from 
here on out.
